subject: Obtain summary statistics for variance from precision

messages.author: 80b903b54c9cf4bd
messages.subject: Obtain summary statistics for variance from precision
parts:
Hi,

I assume I can get the summary statistics for any transformed parameter based on results from inla. For example, currently I have the result for a precision parameter, how can I get the mean and quantiles for the variance parameter? In MCMC settings, as long as  I have the posterior samples, I can get posterior distributions of any quantiles I want. Although I can first generate some samples and then calculate the statistics, I imagine there would be a better way.

In addition, is there any reference for manipulating the results from inla? I'm kind of blind in doing that since every pieces I am using now is by searching papers/examples and seeing how other people did those. It would be better if I can have a manual telling me all available function I can use to transform, get quantities, etc, based on my inla results.

Thanks,

Jiang

messages.author: 936ef8c6d12fc338
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Obtain summary statistics for variance from precision
parts:
Dear Jiang,

You are looking for the inla.tmarginal() function. E.g. inla.tmarginal(fun = function(x){1/x}, marginal) calculates the marginal of the variance based on the marginal of the precision. Then you can apply inla.zmarginal() or inla.emarginal() to get the values you want.

Best regards,
